item.title: Shocked Cat Weekend Meme

turns.text: Make a square meme with this cat photo. Top text: "WHEN YOU THINK IT'S FRIDAY" Bottom text: "BUT IT'S ONLY TUESDAY". Big white letters with black outlines, and keep the cat's eyes clear.

item.tests: Tests faithful use of an attached meme template with exact, legible captions and unobscured facial expression.

answer_sheet.Template: Use the attached cat-surprised.jpg, not a newly generated cat.
answer_sheet.Caption wording and placement: Top: WHEN YOU THINK IT'S FRIDAY. Bottom: BUT IT'S ONLY TUESDAY.
answer_sheet.Style: Classic meme lettering: big white letters with black outlines. Keep the cat's eyes clear.

must_haves: The image uses the attached shocked-cat photo, retaining the same cat and sofa setting.
The top caption reads exactly 'WHEN YOU THINK IT'S FRIDAY'.
The bottom caption reads exactly 'BUT IT'S ONLY TUESDAY'.
Both captions have large white letters with black outlines, are fully visible, and are readable.
The cat's wide eyes remain unobscured in a square composition.

style.prompt: Turn this exact cat photo into a square classic meme. Preserve the original photo and surprised cat appearance, especially the eyes, unchanged and unobstructed. Add top text exactly: "WHEN YOU THINK IT'S FRIDAY". Add bottom text exactly: "BUT IT'S ONLY TUESDAY". Use large bold condensed uppercase white letters with thick black outlines, centered, readable, within image edges. Wrap the top caption into two lines in the upper margin above the cat's eyes, and bottom caption into two lines near the bottom below the face. Do not cover either eye. No other words.
